entries.14143adb1e8877eb: A company that makes and sells construction machinery and mining machinery such as hydraulic excavators and wheel loaders, and also handles parts and services.
entries.ea0a439d30219c38: This business develops, manufactures and sells parts and provides service solutions for mining equipment and machinery after they are sold. It handles after-sales service for mining equipment and machinery not included in the construction machinery business. Australia's Bradken Pty Limited and its subsidiaries manufacture cast parts for the mining and infrastructure industries, provide mining wear parts and maintenance services, and the United States' H-E Parts International LLC and its subsidiaries provide service solutions. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥136,974 million (prior year: ¥127,371 million), an increase, partly due to the consolidation of Brake Supply Co., INC. of the United States, a business acquired in December 2024. There are no property, plant or equipment matters for this segment that should be disclosed.
